name: Claude Code
description: Anthropic 官方 Agent 编程助手 CLI，支持沙箱内代码全自动探索与工程演进。
installSteps: if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm || true; fi

npm_config_prefix="$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR" npm install -g --ignore-scripts @anthropic-ai/claude-code --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com || npm_config_prefix="$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR" npm install -g --ignore-scripts @anthropic-ai/claude-code

printf '#!/usr/bin/env sh
MODULE_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code" && pwd)"
if [ -f "$MODULE_DIR/cli-wrapper.cjs" ]; then
    exec node "$MODULE_DIR/cli-wrapper.cjs" "$@"
elif [ -f "$MODULE_DIR/cli.js" ]; then
    exec node "$MODULE_DIR/cli.js" "$@"
else
    exec node "$MODULE_DIR/index.js" "$@"
fi
' > "$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/bin/claude"

name: llama.cpp 本地推理引擎
description: 在 ARM64 Linux 沙箱内运行 GGUF 模型，并提供 OpenAI 兼容的本地推理接口。
installSteps: case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64|arm64) ;; *) echo 'llama.cpp 本地推理仅支持 ARM64/aarch64' >&2; exit 64;; esac

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential cmake curl ca-certificates; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then apk add --no-cache build-base cmake curl ca-certificates linux-headers; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then pacman -Sy --noconfirm --needed base-devel cmake curl ca-certificates; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf install -y gcc-c++ cmake make curl ca-certificates; elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then zypper --non-interactive install gcc-c++ cmake make curl ca-certificates; else echo '当前发行版缺少受支持的包管理器，无法安装 C++ 构建工具链' >&2; exit 65; fi

LLAMA_SOURCE_URL=$(python3 -c 'import json,urllib.request; print(json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.github.com/repos/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/latest"))["tarball_url"])') && test -n "$LLAMA_SOURCE_URL" && curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$LLAMA_SOURCE_URL" -o /tmp/taixu-llama-cpp-source.tar.gz && rm -rf "$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/src/llama.cpp" && mkdir -p "$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/src/llama.cpp" && tar -xzf /tmp/taixu-llama-cpp-source.tar.gz -C "$TAIXU_TOOL_DIR/src/llama.cpp" --strip-components=1 && rm -f /tmp/taixu-llama-cpp-source.tar.gz
verifyCommand: case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64|arm64) llama-server --version;; *) exit 1;; esac
